narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack tangled · EMA spread -4.90 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 5.559-5.652 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 5.756; the first objective pays 1.48R at 5.586.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 5.559-5.652
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 5.756 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
